changes: Git fixture scripts now use the existing fixed native CLI bridge, returning the same stderr and exit 128. Clone token is located without assuming argv[1], so invocation-local -c core.longpaths works.
Path-relative assertions use the native separator. Cleanup verifies both old .clone- and new Windows .paperclip-clone- staging prefixes.
tsx loader is passed as a file URL. Only the local POSIX sandbox boundary maps paths/shell binaries; direct native probe receives its canonical filesystem root.
Windows mode mutation uses its real supported read-only bit, preserving the POSIX executable-bit case.

Remote-scratch invalid inputs use a valid POSIX base so rejection is not vacuous. Sandbox children use explicit own HOME/TEMP and inheritEnv:false, retaining only system/PATH and deliberate fixture env.

Board native Windows branches retain binding/reassignment and HTTP download success, assert attachment_staging_failed with null path, zero-byte staged files and unchanged attachment rows. POSIX original native staging success remains.
productionScope: No production changed by these three test fixes. Root-owned workspaces.ts separately corrects Windows drive paths parsed as c: URLs, uses invocation-local longpaths, and bounds clone staging names; that production has separate root verification.
windowsStagingLimit: Opaque empty staging slots/directories may be created; no payload bytes are admitted and no extra binding is persisted. No Windows local native descriptor-support claim is made.
limits: No global Git configuration or actual external credentials/providers were used.
The archive transport is a real local POSIX shell fixture on Windows, not a live Daytona/SSH qualification.
Local descriptor guards are preserved; successful authenticated Board download does not imply native staging support.
